周東佑京の2026年目標は「ホームラン」だった――“足の人”というラベルはいつ更新されるのか

Ukyo Shuto's 2026 Hawks profile gives the same answer twice: his baseball goal is 'home run,' and the play he wants fans to watch is also 'home run.' 2026年9月7日時点で盗塁27はパ・リーグ1位、通算盗塁257に対して通算本塁打は19。The mismatch looks funny at first. But after tracing his 13-game stolen-base streak, the 10.28-second WBC run, back-to-back Best Nine and Gold Glove awards, and a Japan Series record of five hits in one game, the stranger thing is how slowly our image of a player updates.
